split_execution: test-all runs normal and challenge splits concurrently with separate memory, outputs, runtime caches and temporary paths. Tasks within each split remain sequential. Wait for both splits; either failure fails the invocation. Recovery skips completed splits.
consolidation_prompt_policy: Defer candidates before the consolidation provider call when complete system and user messages exceed 900000 UTF-8 bytes. Record byte counts and the reason in updates.json; preserve all raw evidence, references and existing memory. Continue subsequent candidates. This conservative byte budget is not a token estimate.
parent_variant: reme-origin-embedding3large (executor and prompt lineage; new MetaWeft memory policy)
parent_source: metaskill-appworld/baselines/reme2f37a15/benchmark/appworld/appworld_react_agent.py and prompt.py; bundled upstream 2f37a159b72a04ac1885a7db7f1a663a833e7791; inspected sibling checkout 2bd51dabc0e84c2d6aa9f9db66e630a78f58ab94 with local integration changes. Reuses sibling AppWorld loader/evaluator, experiments/code/common runner/episodes/lm_logger, and run lifecycle/runtime helpers. Each invocation preserves actual MetaWeft and sibling working-source snapshots plus hashes; the revision alone is not the executed-source record.
hypothesis: A procedural-memory pipeline combining task-conditioned adaptation and evidence-grounded semantic consolidation can improve ordered-task reuse relative to matched direct execution. V1 smoke tests establish pipeline operation, not a performance improvement.
intended_differences: Replace native ReMe retrieval formatting and success-only summary/addition/utility eviction with one adaptation pass, reflection on successes and failures, and sequential add/skip/revise/defer consolidation. Use 40 executor interactions and configurable provider retries (five retries after the initial attempt, with 60-second waits by default) and completed-task recovery. Compare the complete system with metaweft-direct-v1; this is not an adaptation-only ablation or exact ReMe reproduction.
memory_structure: Flat per-stream Elasticsearch records with stable IDs, when_to_use, procedural content, supporting source-evidence references, and a 1024-dimensional text-embedding-3-large vector of when_to_use plus content. Snapshot the complete records, vectors, and mapping. No graph, multi-index representation, utility eviction, or implicit truncation.
retrieval: The shared memory_retrieval framework's base configuration embeds the exact task instruction and returns up to five combined-vector neighbors before execution; single-list RRF preserves their order. Use fewer when available and skip guidance when empty. Snapshot resolved retrieval meta and trace queries, rankings, raw scores and canonical call references. Candidate consolidation separately retrieves up to five neighbors against the current store, including earlier confirmed writes from the same task. Expanded retrieval presets are evaluated separately and are not live settings.
adaptation: One fixed versioned prompt conditions retrieved records on the current task and returns execution guidance, including empty guidance when none applies. No iterative retrieval or adaptation. Exhausted provider calls stop the stream; other retrieval/adaptation failures retain visible fallback to no guidance; no extra LLM repair of invalid structured output.
execution_context: ReMe-derived AppWorld ReAct execution with qwen3.8-flash, temperature 0.9, seed 0, thinking disabled, at most 40 interactions, and one primary trial. Attach adapted guidance once to the initial task context. Base owns an explicit executor prompt initially matched to direct's separate prompt. Shared official loading, evaluation, and canonical logging remain in use. Chat/embedding attempts time out after 120/30 seconds; provider exceptions and invalid/empty responses allow five retries after the initial attempt with 60-second waits by default; effective settings are preserved per run. AppWorld environment random_seed=100 is distinct from the model seed.
evidence_update: After execution, preserve the task specification, full trace, and official scalar reward. One temperature-zero reflection pass proposes at most three candidates from success or failure, distinguishing demonstrated knowledge from inference/untested fixes. Sequential consolidation consults up to five neighbors and their preserved allowed evidence, then adds, skips, revises with supporting provenance, or defers unresolved conflicts. Complete confirmed updates before advancing. On a non-provider reflection/consolidation failure, retain confirmed prior writes and log failure plus skipped remaining work. Provider exhaustion stops without committing the unfinished task; partial updates remain failure evidence and are excluded from recovered memory. No automatic deletion; missing evidence cannot justify an unsupported overwrite.
feedback_access: Executor receives task/API descriptions, environment observations, and adapted guidance. Adaptation sees the task and retrieved records. Reflection and consolidation may consume only task specifications, preserved execution traces, and scalar rewards, including matched memories' referenced evidence. Reference solutions, private evaluator data, and official assertion text remain evaluation-only. Evidence references resolve to preserved run artifacts.
memory_lifetime: Fresh empty memory per independent run and test split; ordered tasks share completed updates. Every task requires a verified checkpoint export. Recovery restores the last committed memory into a new isolated index, preserving IDs, full vectors and evidence references. Writable stores, databases, runtime caches and outputs remain isolated; the completed LLM response cache is shared, with no_cache by default and reuse only in cache/timed_cache modes. No training, arbitrary warm-start import, within-task resume or task parallelism.
failure_reporting: Exhausted provider calls in any stage are fatal and leave the last committed checkpoint recoverable. Non-provider memory fallbacks remain explicit degraded outcomes. Canonical logging, provenance, required checkpoint exports, execution infrastructure and evaluation failures are fatal. Optional final snapshot failures remain phase evidence gaps. Completion is separate from benchmark success. Cumulative, current-attempt and inherited accounting retain failed calls and unknown usage/cost.
recovery_protocol: Recovery format 1; only newly created runs are eligible. Resume committed tasks in a new linked invocation using the original captured source, prompts, settings, task order, benchmark data and runtime. Restart the unfinished task from the preceding checkpoint; preserve failed parent artifacts and account for every physical call across attempts. No within-task resume or provider-model substitution detection.
